The background includes a building facade with windows and some greenery. The image exhibits significant compression artifacts and motion blur.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Significant motion blur on the jumping child and general softness/compression blur in the background vegetation and building details. This reduces structural clarity but is likely due to camera capture/low resolution rather than AI generation failure, though it mimics AI smoothing.
